FIELDS.NAME: Cozy Corner Upholstery Services
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Cozy Corner Upholstery Services specializes in high-quality upholstery solutions for both residential and commercial clients. Our operations encompass a wide range of services, including reupholstering furniture, repairing upholstery damage, and custom fabric installations to enhance the aesthetic and comfort of various spaces. We employ a team of skilled professionals, ensuring a high standard of craftsmanship in all projects. 

We utilize industry-standard equipment and materials that allow us to deliver reliable and durable results. Our documented safety protocols ensure that all chemicals and machinery are handled safely, minimizing the risk of accidents within our workshop and during on-site services. For mobile operations, we maintain comprehensive commercial auto insurance with adequate liability limits, protecting our team and clients during transportation. 

We also emphasize customer satisfaction through established feedback mechanisms, allowing us to continually improve our services and respond promptly to client needs. Regular audits of our safety and quality control measures are conducted to ensure compliance with industry standards. Our commitment to following local regulations and maintaining staff development programs helps us mitigate risks effectively and maintain a professional work environment.
